full_text:
On the show, @marshallmixing and @katemparkman get into:

• The Treasury yield hit 5.34%, the highest since 2007, and the Treasury responded by doubling long-end bond buybacks from $2B to $4B per operation starting September 9. The dollar hit a 2.5-month low, gold rallied past $4,500, and Bitcoin surged 7% in a day, its biggest move since March, with $1.4B in shorts liquidated in four hours and $517M in ETF inflows.

• @Bullish IPO'd and revealed 24,300 BTC, the sixth-largest public company Bitcoin holder, ahead of @strive, @SpaceX, and @coinbase.

• @Metaplanet is coming to America: a controlling stake in Super League Enterprise, renamed SuperPlanet (SUPA), seeded with 2,100 of its own BTC. Expected to close Q4.

• The SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets: a one-time $5M exemption over four years, a $75M annual exemption, and a safe harbor for qualifying crypto assets.

• Clarity gets its Senate cloture vote September 15: 60 votes needed, at least seven Democrats have to cross the aisle.

• OrdinalsBot is winding down and looking for bids to keep the brand alive. End of an era.

• Treasury tracker: @strive +79 BTC (20,246), Gemini +1,698 revealed (5,528), @_ALCPB +5 (3,145), Canaan +2 (1,917), Remixpoint +9.98 (1,501). @strategy: no buys, no sells; +$150M USD reserve and $132M of STRC bought back.

• Follow the show on X: @goodforbtc.
